name: Rim Atmosphere
description: Presentation only (19i): the outer rim of the galaxy looks, sounds and reads colder, darker and lonelier — cold colour grading, dark dust lanes, grainy murk over unexplored rim systems, derelict hulks, eyes in the dark (small blinking red pairs) in rim systems, dimmer lights, barely visible wind motes at system zoom, and a faint vignette and film grain deep in the rim (screen effects only from mid zoom in, never at the galaxy view); a sparse music mood and a near-silent synthesised ambient bed (deep-water rumble, rare distant wind gusts, sonar pings, hull groans, bubbling, very rare whale-like calls) that grows a little denser with distance; quiet distant synthesised creature calls and hull creaks at system zoom; bleaker rim system names and rim-flavoured message wording; rare garbled distress calls from rim outposts. No gameplay change.

flags.name: rimAtmosphere
flags.label: Rim atmosphere
flags.description: Draw the rim atmosphere visuals (off = the map draws as the base game).

params.name: rimInner
params.label: Rim starts at (fraction of galaxy radius)

params.name: vignetteStrength
params.label: Rim vignette strength (0 = off)
params.description: How much the screen corners dim once the camera is deep in the rim (fades in past ~half the rim band; kept subtle).

params.name: grainStrength
params.label: Rim film grain strength (0 = off)
params.description: Fine, faint film grain over the view once the camera is deep in the rim.

params.name: windStrength
params.label: Rim wind motes (0 = off)
params.description: Barely visible wind motes drifting through rim systems at system zoom, with gentle gusts.

params.name: rimMapLook
params.label: Rim look on the galaxy map
params.description: 0 = flat cold wash (original), 1 = dark dust haze band at the rim edge, 2 = slowly drifting dark nebula wisps, 3 = cold-blue gradient falloff.

params.name: musicMoodWeight
params.label: Rim music mood strength
params.description: How strongly the music selector prefers sparse/subdued tracks once the camera is past the rim.

params.name: ambientGain
params.label: Rim ambient bed gain
params.description: Level of the sparse wind / underwater ambient bed once the camera is fully past the rim (share of a hard cap kept well under the music; the level ramps gently with rim depth).

params.name: staticGain
params.label: Rim voice static gain
params.description: Level of the faint, soft static under advisor/diplomacy voice playback deep in the fog band (share of a low cap; ramps with the square of rim depth).

params.name: distressCallRate
params.label: Rim distress-call rate
params.description: Chance per check (every 6 game days) of a garbled distress-call ticker line from a rim outpost at the rim's outer edge.

params.name: creatureCallRate
params.label: Distant creature-call rate
params.description: How often a creature near the camera calls at system zoom (synthesised; 1 = one call attempt every ~12 s deep in the rim, 15% of that in the core).

params.name: creakRate
params.label: Hull creak rate
params.description: How often the hull of the selected / nearest own ship creaks at system zoom while it is in a storm, hyperjumping or deep in the rim (synthesised).

params.name: creatureCallGain
params.label: Creature-call gain
params.description: Gain of the synthesised creature calls (also scaled by the effects volume, distance and rim weight).

params.name: creakGain
params.label: Hull creak gain
params.description: Gain of the synthesised hull creaks (also scaled by the effects volume and distance).
